info.title: email8-store
info.description: Sentin8 Email8:Store - mail/collaboration data core + JMAP API.

get.summary:
`GET /jmap/ws` - RFC 8887 JMAP over WebSocket. After the upgrade the
server accepts JMAP `Request` frames as text messages and replies with
`Response` frames; unsolicited `StateChange` pushes are emitted when
the changelog advances. Auth is via the `access_token` query param
(browsers cannot set headers on the upgrade request).
`GET /v1/admin/ui/{page}` - RFW definition for the requested page.

post.summary: `POST /v1/admin/{page}` - data for the admin viewer pages.

`POST /v1/internal/email/store` - store the raw blob for an APPEND
(IMAP/POP3 upload path): bytes → Storage, blob-hash returned.

`POST /v1/internal/sieve/put` - store a compiled script (blob →
Storage, row upsert).

`POST /v1/internal/sieve/setactive` - flip the active script (only one
may be active; the row flips + the account pointer updates).

`POST /v1/internal/submit` - enqueue a submission into the Mta queue.
Store proxies to Mta (it owns the queue); the response is Mta's.

AdminUiResponse.description:
The response from an admin UI endpoint.

- `GET /v1/admin/ui/{page}` → `AdminUiResponse::Page(page_def)`
- `POST /v1/admin/{resource}` → `AdminUiResponse::Page(updated_page_def)` or `AdminUiResponse::Redirect(route)`

AppendRequest.description:
`POST /v1/internal/ingest/append` - IMAP APPEND / POP3-compatible
upload: raw bytes → blob → email row + membership in one call.

imap_uid.description: The UID assigned in the target mailbox (absent in preview-only paths).

ChangesSinceRequest.description: A change-log window query (JMAP `/changes`, IMAP QRESYNC since).

ContainerDirection.description: Layout direction for a container's children.

DestroyEmailsRequest.description:
`POST /v1/internal/emails/destroy` - batch expunge (POP3 QUIT, IMAP
EXPUNGE). Only removes the membership row (message moves to no
mailbox → eligible for GC; the POP3/IMAP destroy is a membership
delete + `destroyed` changelog entries).

EmailDoc.description:
`POST /v1/internal/resolve` - RCPT resolution (sub-addressing, aliases,
catch-all, group expansion).
An email with its mailbox memberships (wire mirror of the stored doc;
`metadata` stays a value field per JMAP).

IngestMessage.description:
Raw message ingestion - the single entry point Mta local delivery,
IMAP APPEND and JMAP Email/import all funnel through.

blob_hash.description: Storage content-address key for the raw message bytes.

ham_override.description: Skip spam re-file when the sender is a known-ham address.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key - (blob_hash, mailbox set, envelope) dedup.

mailboxes.description: Mailbox ids to file into; defaults to INBOX.

source.description: Source metadata for the change log + spam overrides.

spam_percentage.description: Pre-computed spam percentage (0-100) - ≥50 re-files to JUNK.

JmapBatch.description:
The JMAP request/response batch (RFC 8620 §3.6): method calls are
extension-defined - same transparent-wrapper treatment.

JmapSessionDocument.description:
`GET /jmap/session` - the RFC 8620 session resource.
The JMAP `session` document (RFC 8620 §2): capability objects are
extension-defined, so the document is dynamic - documented as a
transparent wrapper (wire-true, schema non-empty).

JmapUploadResult.description: Blob-upload result (RFC 9404 §4; the jmap-proto helper shape).

uid.description: The IMAP UID in the mailbox.
